content.short: Brazilian digital bank with cards, accounts and business services.
content.description: C6 Bank, launched in 2019 and now part-owned by JPMorgan, is one of Brazil's largest digital banks, serving tens of millions of individuals and small businesses. Through its app it offers free checking accounts, credit and debit cards, a global account for spending abroad, investments, loans, and the C6 Tag for contactless payments, plus dedicated products for SMEs. Customers manage everyday banking, Pix instant transfers, bill payments, and international spending from a single mobile experience. By bundling accounts, cards, credit, and investments into one platform, C6 Bank competes with both incumbent Brazilian banks and other neobanks, generating high volumes of card and payment activity across consumer and business segments.
